test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Who among the following does NOT participate in the election of the President of India?

options.text: Elected members of legislative council of state

solution:
The correct answer is __**Elected members of legislative council of state**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of **the elected members** of both Houses of Parliament and the elected members of the Legislative Assemblies of States and Union territories (with legislatures).
 
• The **legislative councils** in states, where they exist, are not involved in the process as their members are not part of the electoral college.
 
• Legislative councils are the **upper houses** in bicameral legislatures of some Indian states and have limited roles in legislative and governance processes.
 
• This arrangement ensures a wider representation of the country’s federal structure while excluding unelected members from participating in the Presidential election.
 
• Hence, **elected members of the legislative council** do not participate in the election of the President of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electoral College for Presidential Election:**

 
 
• The electoral college comprises **only elected representatives** from the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State/Union Territory Legislative Assemblies.
 
• Nominated members of Parliament and state legislatures are excluded, as are members of legislative councils.
 
 
 
• **States with Legislative Councils:**
 
 
• As of now, only six states in India have legislative councils: **Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar, and Karnataka.**
 
• These councils serve as advisory bodies, with members elected through indirect elections or nominated by the Governor.
 
 
 
• **Presidential Election Process:**
 
 
• The election follows the **proportional representation system** through a single transferable vote.
 
• Each vote carries a value based on the population of the state or Union Territory the voter represents.
 
 
 
• **Role of Legislative Councils:**
 
 
• Legislative councils primarily act as a **review body** for legislation passed by the legislative assemblies.
 
• They have no direct role in the election of the President of India.
